title: This Fish Survives 4 Years Without Food or Water

scenes.text: This fish can survive four years without food or water.
It's the West African lungfish, and it breathes air.
When the river dries up, it digs into the mud.
It wraps itself in a cocoon of slime and its body slows almost to a stop.
Years later, the rain comes back, and the fish swims away.
Four years sealed in mud. Then it just swims.

description:
The West African lungfish can go without eating for about four years, possibly five, by burying itself in mud and entering a dormant state called aestivation.
The record is held in Guinness World Records for longest time without food for a fish.
Could you last even one day without water?
first_comment: Bonus: it breathes air with a lung, which is how it survives out of water. Which animal would you pick to survive a drought?
